name: feature
description: Ship a feature: plan, then build+research in parallel, test, review, CI gate.

stages.name: plan
stages.task:
Break this objective into an ordered, testable implementation plan with dependencies and a definition of done for each step:

{task}

stages.name: code
stages.task:
Implement the following plan. Match the project's existing style, add tests, and verify the build.

{stage.plan}

stages.name: research
stages.task:
Research anything the implementation needs (APIs, library versions, best practices, gotchas) for this objective. Cite sources.

{task}

stages.name: test
stages.task:
Write and run tests for the implementation. Report pass/fail with evidence.
{deps}

stages.name: review
stages.task:
Review the implementation and tests for correctness, security, and style. Give a clear verdict; say NEEDS_CHANGES if the coder must revise.
{deps}

stages.name: cigate
stages.task:
Run the CI gate (lint/build/test). Report the verdict as the last line: 'CI: PASS' or 'CI: FAIL'.
{stage.review}
